extracted text: The paper compares mechanical and corrosion properties of A356-T6 alloy produced by rheocasting and low-pressure casting. Both products were T6 heat treated (solution heat-treated at 528°C for 5h, water quenched and aged at 170°C for 6h). The fatigue endurance limit was approximately 105 MPa for both products. The pitting corrosion potential value for the RC product was -600 mV versus Ag/AgCl, while it was -650 mV versus Ag/AgCl for the LP counterpart.
